Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
I bought this E-210 to replace a nearly 20-year old Genesis grill. The E-210 is no comparison to the built quality of the Genesis grills, but the E-210 is nearly half the price. 

Assembly was not difficult but it did take a couple of hours to complete. The E-210 gets hot quick and cooks great just like the old Genesis did. 

Overall I’d say the E-210 is no upscale grill but it’s exactly what I needed at a good price point. I don’t expect the E-210 to last 20-years and I’m okay with that.
Results.Title: Exactly what I wanted at the price point

Results.ReviewText: Grill arrived with a broken gas Regulator.  Weber was good about sending out a replacement part - no problem about that. However, this was not an easy thing to do unless you are VERY strong and they do not have a system in place to to repair their grills.  I live in SF Bay area so this not a remote area - I felt like they could have somebody in the region to do this.  Finally I got a neighbor to come over to make the fix, but I felt it should not be my problem to fix a new grill.  Other than that, it really is a great little grill for somebody who does not need a huge expensive one.

Results.ReviewText: I love my new Weber grill. It replaced a 2-yr old still working big-box grill. I was burning, or under cooking, everything I grilled. After a lot of research, I decided to spend the extra money to “ invest” in a Weber grill. The difference in quality construction is immediately obvious. It heats up quickly and the temperature is easily controlled. The grates are ease to clean, which is a big plus. I have a two-burner grill and like the fact that I have the option to purchase a Weber griddle to replace one of the grates. I wish I had purchased my grill earlier in the summer. I look forward to doing more grilling next year!
Results.Title: Weber Equals Quality

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
